learnings: nudge_gripper.py works: protocol 0, torque enable (reg 40), goal position (reg 42), present position (reg 56). Positive steps = open, negative = close. Resting ~2400.
motor_server.py is read-only — no write endpoint. Must stop server to use serial port from another script.
sandbox must be disabled for serial port access (dangerouslyDisableSandbox).
Calibration data has NOT been collected yet — JSON files at ~/.cache/huggingface/lerobot/calibration/ do not exist.
